name: Dogfood 035: RFC 0032 cross-repo workflows and MCP mutation capabilities

native_delegation.instruction: Use native delegation aggressively for parallelizable work that meets the criteria in the implement prompt. The parent session remains accountable for Striatum artifacts, write scope, verification, and completion.
Use sub-agents aggressively for bounded independent research, review, and code/test/doc authorship. Do not let native delegation obscure the parent session's artifact and verdict accountability.
Use local sub-agents only for bounded independent work. Do not rely on remote agent-to-agent delegation or hidden state as provenance.

jobs.title: Design RFC 0032 cross-repo + MCP mutation from Codex
jobs.objective: Produce an implementation design for RFC 0032: workflow `repositories` block schema, cross-repo workflow validator extensions, daemon-mediated cross-repo coordinator with best-effort consistency on crash, per-repo write-scope enforcement, cross-repo cycle accounting, MCP mutation capability vocabulary expansion (`write`/`review`/`claim`/`apply`/`admin`/`recovery` over the RFC 0030 method registry), per-token `tools/list` filtering, and audit shape for cross-repo + MCP-mutation requests. The design must sit on top of dogfood-034's daemon RPC + supervision scaffold without rebuilding any of it.

jobs.title: Design RFC 0032 cross-repo + MCP mutation from Claude Code
jobs.objective: Produce an implementation design for RFC 0032 emphasizing trust boundaries (operator, daemon, MCP client, supervised lane), capability authorization for mutation tools, default-deny gating, prompt-injection mitigation, cross-repo run lifecycle (prepare/start/run-summary/cancel), and the daemon-DB + repo-local-DB coordination during a cross-repo run.

jobs.title: Design RFC 0032 cross-repo + MCP mutation from Gemini
jobs.objective: Produce an implementation design for RFC 0032 emphasizing cross-platform reality (cross-repo paths and identity across macOS/Linux/Windows-via-WSL), per-repo failure isolation (one repo unavailable mid-run), MCP capability tokens with short expiries for mutation, MCP `tools/call` audit pattern, and operator UX for granting/revoking apply tokens scoped to one repository within a cross-repo workflow.

jobs.title: Synthesize RFC 0032 cross-repo + MCP mutation implementation plan
jobs.objective: Reconcile all three fresh design artifacts into one implementation plan for RFC 0032. Pick concrete schema for the `repositories` workflow block, cross-repo run lifecycle semantics, daemon-mediated coordination + recovery, MCP capability vocabulary mapping, default-deny gating, per-token `tools/list` filtering. Sit on top of dogfood-034's daemon RPC scaffold. EXPLICITLY DEFER multi-repo / cross-repo end-to-end integration testing to the multi-repo test harness RFC queued as `docs/TODO.md` Open item 19; the dogfood-035 implementation may ship unit-level tests and single-repo mock coverage where applicable, with the harness-level tests landing after the harness RFC.

jobs.title: Threat-model review of RFC 0032 design
jobs.objective: Review the synthesized cross-repo + MCP-mutation plan against explicit trust boundaries: prompt-injected MCP client requesting elevated mutation, capability token leaked across repos, daemon crash mid-cross-repo run, one repository unregistered mid-run, per-repo write-scope bypass through cross-repo job target, audit row appended for every mutating MCP `tools/call` including denials, and operator-mistake footguns (e.g. wildcard capability grants). Scope is over-eager AI agents acting through documented interfaces and operator-mistake footguns; per RFC 0031 threat model, malicious-local-root is OUT OF SCOPE.

jobs.title: Implement RFC 0032 cross-repo + MCP mutation V2 slice
jobs.objective: Implement only the reviewed and accepted V2 slice from docs/dogfood/035/DESIGN_SYNTHESIS.md. Multi-repo / cross-repo END-TO-END integration tests are explicitly deferred to a follow-up RFC (TODO Open item 19, multi-repo test harness). Ship unit-level tests, mock-based tests where reasonable, and schema/validator/per-repo-write-scope tests that do not require a multi-repo daemon harness. Use sub-agents aggressively for parallelizable work per the implement prompt. Cycle exhaustion at max_iterations=2 → operator records a decision artifact and continues with the latest verdict; do not block the run.

jobs.title: Threat-model review of RFC 0032 V2 build
jobs.objective: Review the implementation under threat-model posture: capability authorization correctness on every MCP mutation route, audit row appended for every mutating `tools/call` including denials, per-token `tools/list` filtering correctness, default-deny enforcement for unknown methods, cross-repo run state coherence under daemon crash, per-repo write-scope enforcement when a job targets a different registered repo, and absence of raw `.striatum/state.sqlite3` write paths through MCP mutation clients. Multi-repo integration tests are EXPLICITLY deferred to a follow-up RFC; do not refuse the build for lack of cross-repo end-to-end tests as long as unit-level coverage is present and the deferral is documented.
